items.title: Joe Harris Interview, 1961-04-12
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] We're interviewing Mr. Joe Harris today and Harold Dajon is here and Bill Russell and Ralph Collins.

ctx.x: We're interviewing Mr. Joe Harris today and Harold Dajon is here and Bill Russell and Ralph Collins. What is the address? 3905 Chapitula. 3905 Chapitula. Can you give your full name Mr. Harris? Have any middle name or initial? Joseph Dennis Harris. Do you mind telling just when you were born and where? I was born in Lutche, Louisiana, St. James Parish, April 24th, 1999. That's St. James? St. James. That's on the other side of the river? On this side. It's on this side? Yes. It's up near Laplace? About five or six…
St. James across the river, Laplace across the river, on both sides of the river.
